      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity must administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board described in paragraph (2) that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.",
        "actor": "private, nonprofit entity",
        "actor_quote": "private, nonprofit entity",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F003"
        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,

        "logic_quote": null,

          "section 9902(1)",
          "paragraph (2)"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F005:F010",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For a private nonprofit entity's tripartite board under paragraph (1), the members of the board must be selected by the entity and the board must be composed so as to assure that: (A) ⅓ of the members of the board are elected public officials holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives (except that if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting such ⅓ requirement); (B)(i) not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served; and (ii) each representative of low-income individuals and families selected to represent a specific neighborhood within a community under clause (i) resides in the neighborhood represented by the member; and (C) the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.",
        "actor": "the entity",
        "actor_quote": "the entity",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "The members of the board referred to in paragraph (1)",

        "choice_quote": null,

          "clause (i)"

    },

      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "If the number of elected public officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting the ⅓ elected public official requirement.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board",
        "scope_quotes": [
          "F006"
        ],

        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F012:F018",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity must administer the community services block grant program through either (1) a tripartite board, which must have members selected by the organization and must be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members (A) are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, (B) reside in the neighborhood served, and (C) are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter; or (2) another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter.",
        "actor": "the entity",
        "actor_quote": "the entity",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title",
        "scope_quotes": [

        ],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": "The public organization must administer the community services block grant program through either (1) a tripartite board meeting specified composition requirements or (2) another mechanism specified by the State.",
        "choice_quote": "F012:F018",

unit_attributes.statement: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity must administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board described in paragraph (2) that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title

unit_attributes.statement: For a private nonprofit entity's tripartite board under paragraph (1), the members of the board must be selected by the entity and the board must be composed so as to assure that: (A) ⅓ of the members of the board are elected public officials holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives (except that if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting such ⅓ requirement); (B)(i) not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served; and (ii) each representative of low-income individuals and families selected to represent a specific neighborhood within a community under clause (i) resides in the neighborhood represented by the member; and (C) the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.
unit_attributes.scope_text: The members of the board referred to in paragraph (1)

unit_attributes.statement: If the number of elected public officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting the ⅓ elected public official requirement.
unit_attributes.scope_text: if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board

unit_attributes.statement: In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title, the entity must administer the community services block grant program through either (1) a tripartite board, which must have members selected by the organization and must be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members (A) are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, (B) reside in the neighborhood served, and (C) are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter; or (2) another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under this chapter.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title
unit_attributes.choice_text: The public organization must administer the community services block grant program through either (1) a tripartite board meeting specified composition requirements or (2) another mechanism specified by the State.

unit_attributes.statement: Prior sections 9910 and 9910a were omitted in the general amendment of this chapter by Pub. L. 105–285.
Prior section 9910 (Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 681, Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 518, as amended) related to the discretionary authority of the Secretary.
Prior section 9910a (Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 681A, as added Pub. L. 98–558, title II, § 206, Oct. 30, 1984, 98 Stat. 2886, as amended) related to community food and nutrition.

Prior section 9910b (Pub. L. 99–425, title IV, § 408, Sept. 30, 1986, 100 Stat. 972, as amended), which related to demonstration partnership agreements addressing needs of poor, was transferred to section 9925 of this title.

Prior section 9910c (Pub. L. 97–35, title VI, § 682, as added Pub. L. 103–252, title II, § 205(2), May 18, 1994, 108 Stat. 655, as amended) related to national or regional programs designed to provide instructional activities for low-income youth, prior to the general amendment of this chapter by Pub. L. 105–285.

Prior section 9910d (Pub. L. 100–485, title V, § 505, Oct. 13, 1988, 102 Stat. 2404, as amended), which related to demonstration partnership agreements addressing needs of poor, was transferred to section 9926 of this title.
